svg.text: The system (checked) is right on 66 of 110, and on 44 of the 88 answerable questions (50%). The baseline is 13 of 88 (15%).

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Where the system and the baseline disagree, the system wins 35 questions and loses 4 (exact McNemar, p below 0.0001).

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Structured lookups score high because this set is templated: code reads the form of the question and queries the store. Real questions may be less regular.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fabricated advisory or CVE IDs: 0 of 110 in every row. The whole-package row costs $0.062 a question against $0.030 for the system (prompt caching on).
